en: This is a black-and-white vintage postcard showing a large institutional building complex with a smaller chapel-like structure on the left. The postcard features handwritten notes in ink and printed text in Croatian at the top. The setting appears to be a hospital with a church, with trees and a cultivated garden area in the foreground. There is also a horse-drawn carriage visible near the entrance.
